title: Sunset Through the Boat Frame, USVI
description: watching the sun drop behind a row of small islands through the boat's own windshield frame, the metal and glass turning gold for just a few minutes, this is the #USVI at its most unplanned and most beautiful. #virginislands #boatsunset #caribbeanwaters
alt_text: Sunset viewed through a boat windshield frame over island silhouettes in the US Virgin Islands

title: Another Angle on a USVI Sunset
description: slightly different framing, same impossibly good sunset, because some evenings in the #USVI deserve more than one photo. the boat hardware catches the light just as much as the sky does. #virginislands #caribbeansunset #boatlife
alt_text: Boat deck and windshield silhouetted against an orange sunset in the US Virgin Islands

title: Catamaran Flyer Docked at Frenchman's Reef
description: storm clouds building dramatically behind the Flyer catamaran docked at #FrenchmansReef, the masts cutting straight up into all that grey, this felt like the ocean deciding whether or not to behave. #stthomas #usvirginislands #stormyseas
alt_text: Catamaran named Flyer docked at Frenchman's Reef marina under stormy clouds in St. Thomas

title: Derby Day Pose, St. Thomas Lionfish Derby
description: another shot from derby day, this one all attitude, sunglasses on, lionfish dangling, mermaid art on full display. the #LionfishDerby in St. Thomas turns out some of the best candid portraits of the season. #usvirginislands #stthomas #reefresponsible
alt_text: Woman posing with a lionfish catch at the 2026 Lionfish Derby event in St. Thomas

title: Flyer Catamaran, Closer Look at Frenchman's Reef
description: a closer look at the Flyer's rigging against the Frenchman's Reef sign and that same moody sky, there's something almost architectural about sailboat masts when you really study them up close in the #USVI. #virginislands #catamaranlife #frenchmansreef
alt_text: Close view of catamaran rigging and masts at Frenchman's Reef dock in St. Thomas

title: Sunset From the Stern, USVI Waters
description: looking back over the boat's stern as the sun drops behind a jagged little peak, the water catching every bit of orange it can hold. evenings like this are exactly why people keep coming back to the #USVI. #virginislands #caribbeansunset #boatdeck
alt_text: Sunset over distant island peaks viewed from the stern of a boat in the US Virgin Islands

title: Hazy Sun Over a USVI Hillside
description: the sun blown out and glowing behind scattered clouds, a hillside of houses tucked into the cliffs below, this is the kind of overexposed, slightly imperfect photo that somehow captures the #USVI better than the polished ones. #virginislands #islandhillside #caribbeanlight
alt_text: Bright sun behind clouds over a cliffside neighborhood in the US Virgin Islands

title: Quiet Cove at Sunrise, USVI
description: two leaning palms, a sliver of white sand, and water so clear it barely counts as an obstacle between you and the hillside beyond. mornings like this in the #USVI feel almost too good to photograph, like the camera can't quite hold all of it. #virginislands #caribbeancove #sunrisebeach
alt_text: Calm cove with palm trees, white sand, and clear turquoise water in the US Virgin Islands at sunrise

title: Same Cove, Different Breath, USVI
description: i circled back to this cove because the light kept shifting and i wanted to catch it one more time, rocks half submerged, the hillside glowing faintly green. the #USVI rewards patience like this. #virginislands #caribbeanbeach #morninglight
alt_text: Tranquil cove with palm trees and rocky shoreline along clear water in the US Virgin Islands

title: One More USVI Sunset for the Road
description: another sunset, another quiet ribbon of gold across the water, because apparently i can't stop photographing the same kind of #USVI evening and somehow it never gets old. some things are worth repeating. #virginislands #caribbeansunset #islandevenings
alt_text: Sun setting over island silhouettes with light reflecting on the water in the US Virgin Islands
